title: Anatocism
summary: ANAT'OCISM, noun [Latin anatocismus, from Gr. again and usury.] Interest upon interest; the taking of compound interest; or the contract by which such interest is secured. [Rarely used.]

inlines.v: ANAT'OCISM, noun [Latin anatocismus, from Gr. again and usury.] Interest upon interest; the taking of compound interest; or the contract by which such interest is secured. [Rarely used.]
